row.evidence: Airbyte's pricing table checks 'User groups & SCIM' only on Pro and Enterprise Flex (both 'Talk to sales'), and the SCIM docs require 'The Pro or Enterprise Flex plan, with SCIM enabled for your organization.'
row.notes: New row. Airbyte Cloud plans: Standard $20/mo (volume-based credits), Plus from $189/mo (adds OIDC SSO), Pro and Enterprise Flex (capacity-based, Contact Sales). Prices shown monthly; usage priced, so per-user fields are null. SCIM 2.0 is a contact-Airbyte add-on to SSO on Pro/Enterprise Flex, SSO must be set up first, and the SCIM UI only lets you pick Okta or Microsoft Entra ID (custom apps; no OIN or Entra gallery app), so Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud are recorded none. Non-expiring bearer token; strict core-schema attribute allowlist (no enterprise extension). Public REST API (all plans) only lists users and manages permissions.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Usage priced, not per user. Pricing table checks Airbyte API and Multitenancy (Multiple Users) on all four plans.

scim.base_url: Shown in Organization settings > SSO > SCIM section after Enable SCIM (pattern not published)

auth.token_source: Organization settings > SSO > SCIM section > Enable SCIM (token shown once; Generate new token to rotate)

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivation or deletion removes the user's organization permissions, all workspace permissions and group memberships in that organization; the Airbyte user account, access to other organizations and the SCIM record are kept so the IdP can reactivate (reactivation restores only baseline organization member access).

filtering.notes: Docs mention unsupported filters return 400 but do not list supported filter attributes.

custom.how: Strict allowlist; schemas array must contain exactly the core User schema, extensions fail the request

roles.how: Permissions are assigned in Airbyte by an organization admin to SCIM-provisioned groups, not through SCIM.

limitations.text: Only Okta or Microsoft Entra ID can be chosen as the SCIM identity provider, and it can't be changed later without support.
Strict attribute allowlist: unsupported attributes or schema extensions (including the enterprise extension) reject the whole request with 400.
No bulk operations, sorting, ETags, nested groups or role assignment over SCIM.
Every provisioned email domain must be verified in Airbyte.
Okta needs a separate provisioning-only custom SWA app because Okta can't add SCIM to the OIDC app; Entra uses a custom non-gallery app.

scim.notes: SCIM is a contact-Airbyte add-on to SSO that the docs and the pricing table restrict to Pro and Enterprise Flex; no add-on price is published.

methods: oauth2_client_credentials (application client ID/secret exchanged for a bearer access token)

capabilities.notes: The public API has only a list-users endpoint plus permission CRUD; no create, invite, update, deactivate or delete user endpoints appear in the reference.

endpoints.purpose: List users in an organization (filter by ids or emails); Organization Admin only
Create a user permission on a workspace or organization (role)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are viewable by organization admins in the UI on Pro and Enterprise Flex; no audit-log API endpoint appears in the API reference.

limitations.text: Access tokens expire in 15 minutes and must be re-requested; tokens act with the permissions of the user who owns the application.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/airbyte/ returns 404; Airbyte documents a custom OIDC app for SSO plus a custom provisioning-only SWA app with SCIM.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (airbyte-tutorial 404); Airbyte documents a custom non-gallery enterprise app.
